_comment: RDC-OS 2.0 Fix #1 (model independence) + Bet 2 (cheap models under the hood). Commands declare a WORK TIER, not a model. This map resolves tier -> model per provider. Swapping models (or providers) is editing this file, not migrating 17 commands. Route each job to the model that does it best.

mechanical._desc: Narrow, repetitive, deterministic work: git/gh scraping, standup/report formatting, drafting a ticket from requirements, bucketing findings. Bet 2 candidates for fine-tuned small models later.

execution._desc: Applying a known pattern: writing tests, splitting a PR, updating docs, fixing review comments. Needs competence, not deep reasoning.

reasoning._desc: Planning and judgement: change requests, PR verdicts, root-cause analysis, disposition, vuln fixes. Keep the strongest model here.
